rules.title: Every S3 bucket has a public access block with all four settings on
rules.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the bucket with all four settings set to true.
rules.checkov_note: Checkov only checks that a public access block is attached, not that all four settings are true.

rules.title: Every S3 bucket has default encryption (AES256 or aws:kms)
rules.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration for the bucket (AES256 at minimum, aws:kms if required).
rules.checkov_note: Checkov requires a KMS key. This gate accepts AES256 as well, to match the scanner in Project 1.

rules.title: Every S3 bucket has versioning enabled
rules.cis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v7.1.0, none
rules.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_versioning for the bucket with status = "Enabled".

rules.title: Every S3 bucket writes server access logs to a log bucket
rules.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_logging for the bucket with a target_bucket. A bucket that only receives logs is exempt.
rules.checkov_note: Agreed on both example folders. Project 1 is stricter: it also fails a bucket that only receives logs.
rules.not_applicable_reason: This bucket is the destination of another bucket's access logs, so it is exempt.

rules.title: Every VPC has a flow log that records rejected traffic
rules.remediation: Add an aws_flow_log for the VPC with traffic_type = "REJECT" or "ALL".
rules.checkov_note: Checkov passes a flow log that records only accepted traffic.

rules.title: No security group allows SSH (port 22) from the whole internet
rules.remediation: Replace the 0.0.0.0/0 (or ::/0) source with a trusted range, or delete the rule.
rules.checkov_note: Agreed in every case tried: IPv6, port ranges, all-protocol rules and the three rule forms.
rules.not_applicable_reason: This is an egress rule (traffic going out), so it is not judged.

rules.title: No security group allows RDP (port 3389) from the whole internet
rules.remediation: Replace the 0.0.0.0/0 (or ::/0) source with a trusted range, or delete the rule.
rules.checkov_note: Agreed on inline rules, port ranges and all-protocol rules. IPv6 and the standalone rule forms were only tried for SSH.
rules.not_applicable_reason: This is an egress rule (traffic going out), so it is not judged.

rules.title: Every CloudTrail trail is multi-region, logging, and records all management events
rules.remediation: Set is_multi_region_trail = true, keep enable_logging = true and record all management events (reads and writes).
rules.checkov_note: Checkov only checks that the trail is multi-region. It passes a trail with logging off or read-only events.

rules.title: Every CloudTrail trail has log file validation enabled
rules.remediation: Set enable_log_file_validation = true on the trail.

rules.title: Every CloudTrail trail encrypts its logs with a KMS key
rules.remediation: Set kms_key_id on the trail to a KMS key.

rules.title: Automatic rotation is enabled on customer-managed KMS keys
rules.remediation: Set enable_key_rotation = true on the key.
rules.not_applicable_reason: This key cannot rotate automatically (asymmetric, disabled or imported key material), so it is not judged.

rules.title: No IAM policy grants full administrator access
rules.remediation: Replace the wildcard action and resource with the specific actions and resources needed, and never attach AdministratorAccess.
rules.checkov_note: Checkov judges policy documents but not attachments of the AdministratorAccess managed policy.
